name: 教室
description: A bright classroom with wooden floors. A teacher in a blue cardigan is standing next to the blackboard and pointing at it. A boy in a yellow shirt is raising his hand. Other students are sitting at their desks, writing in notebooks and reading. There are two windows with yellow curtains, a bookshelf with colorful books, a clock on the wall, a bulletin board, a plant, and a red school bag next to a desk. On the teacher's desk there are books, an apple, and a globe.
elements: a teacher pointing at the blackboard
students sitting at their desks and writing
an apple and a globe on the teacher's desk
a red school bag next to a desk
